implemented: The fixed 20/40/60 grid and budget of three trials must be frozen before development begins.
The evaluator accepts only development rows within the frozen dates and matching the exact data digest; confirmatory/holdout rows and extra horizons are rejected.
All horizons must have matched decision identities and every tried horizon is reported with count, mean holding-period net alpha, and annualized mean.
The durable result record is append-only and immutable; the exploratory leader is not a promotion decision.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; no actual economic horizon comparison is reported.
The existing historical analysis and protected confirmatory data were not reopened.
An approved in-house development dataset and reviewed search protocol remain necessary.
